app.name: HerHealth Liberia
app.tagline: Trusted health information. In your language. In your hands.
app.developedBy: Developed and maintained by SkillBridge Liberia Corporation
app.disclaimer: HerHealth provides educational health information and does not provide medical diagnosis or replace consultation with a qualified healthcare professional.
common.offline: You are offline. Saved content is still available.
welcome.title: Your privacy matters
welcome.intro: HerHealth gives you private, trusted information about reproductive and maternal health. You do not need to give your name or phone number.
welcome.p1: No account, no name, no phone number
welcome.p2: Health information reviewed by registered nurses
welcome.p4: Use Quick Exit at any time to leave fast
language.title: Choose your language
language.more: More languages will be added only after fluent speakers and health reviewers have checked every translation.
home.title: What would you like to know about?
home.askSub: Type or speak your question. It is private.
home.listenSub: Audio for people who prefer to listen
home.reviewed: Clinically reviewed by Registered Nurses licensed under the Liberia Board of Nursing
learn.title: Learn
learn.subtitle: Short health lessons, clinically reviewed by registered nurses.
learn.empty: Lessons for this topic are being prepared and reviewed. Please check again soon.
article.audioDevice: Read aloud by your phone's voice (no download needed)
article.sourceNote: Written in plain language from these sources. It does not imply endorsement by these organizations.
article.notInLanguage: This lesson is not yet available in your language. It is shown in English until a reviewed translation is ready.
ask.title: Ask HerHealth
ask.subtitle: Ask a private question about reproductive or maternal health.
ask.voiceNote: Voice input uses your browser's speech service. Turn it off if you prefer to type.
ask.voiceUnsupported: Voice input is not available on this browser. Please type your question.
ask.s1: What is HPV and how can women protect themselves?
ask.s2: When should I start antenatal care?
ask.notStored: Your question is not saved. HerHealth is not a doctor and cannot diagnose.
ask.tooShort: Please type a little more so HerHealth can understand your question.
ask.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ask.offline: You are offline. Ask HerHealth needs a connection — your saved lessons still work.
ask.seekCare: Get help from a health worker if…
ask.amberNote: Because you mentioned a symptom, it is a good idea to talk to a qualified health professional, especially if it is severe, getting worse or not going away.
emergency.title: Emergency information
emergency.lead: If someone is in danger right now, go to the nearest health facility immediately or ask someone near you to help you get there.
emergency.signs: Danger signs that need urgent care
emergency.noNumbers: No verified emergency telephone numbers have been published yet. HerHealth never shows a number that has not been checked.
help.title: Find a health service
help.subtitle: Only services checked by the HerHealth team are listed.
help.none: No verified services are currently available for this search. Our team is continuing to verify health-service information.
feedback.title: Tell us what you think
feedback.comment: Comment (optional — please do not include your name or phone number)
feedback.thanks: Thank you. Your feedback helps us improve HerHealth.

impact.subtitle: Live numbers counted from anonymous prototype events. No questions, names or personal health information are ever shown.
